label: Bible Study
prompt: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: _____ shall not rise up the second time.
verse: What do ye imagine against the LORD? he will make an utter end: affliction shall not rise up the second time.
note: Nahum's word to Judah about Assyria's threat — this trouble won't come around a second time.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are _____ in heaven.
verse: Notwithstanding in this rejoice not, that the spirits are subject unto you; but rather rejoice, because your names are written in heaven.
note: The seventy came back thrilled about their power; Jesus said rejoice in something better — your names in heaven.

label: Sunday School
prompt: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod _____ up their rods.
verse: For they cast down every man his rod, and they became serpents: but Aaron's rod swallowed up their rods.
note: Pharaoh's magicians matched the trick, but Aaron's rod had the last word — it swallowed theirs whole.

label: Deep Water
prompt: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in _____ of life.
verse: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
note: Baptism as burial and resurrection: down into death with Christ, up again to walk a brand-new life.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But there is _____ with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
verse: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.
note: Forgiveness doesn't make God casual; it makes him 'feared.' A song of ascents prayed 'out of the depths' (130:1).
